correctness.rationale: For each source kernel block the commuting equation is equivalent to a forced root-to-root map plus independent nonroot choices in the designated target block. Exact inclusion-exclusion counts all possible nonroot image sets; fixed-image parametrization counts idempotents. Distinct target blocks contribute disjoint image sizes, giving the product formulas. Two exhaustive rank-two image types establish the block-profile-independent coefficients, with zero boundary cases. Direct enumeration checks every coefficient for 22 small profiles; finite tests support, not replace, the full combinatorial proof.

originality.rationale: The exact centralizer normal form and rank-one/two structural classes were known, and whole-uniform-partition idempotent totals were known. The new claim is the joint pair of complete rank polynomials for the root-preserving centralizer at arbitrary unequal block sizes and the exact rank-two universality. The most closely inspected full source has a distinct object and totals rather than these spectra. No stronger direct covering statement was found, but some historical sources remain partially accessible and independent priority verification is warranted.

The rank-two rigidity and rank-three profile sensitivity distinguish what information these spectra retain; this is structural quantitative classification, not a fixed tiny census or a renamed total centralizer count.
